CR1.label: Signing in & authentication

CR1.1.label: Login blocked
CR1.1.description: Requests where the user cannot sign in to the platform at all (e.g. login error, account locked or blocked, repeated failed login attempts, Cloudflare block, inactive CHIEF account, or login prevented for any reason).

CR1.2.label: Password
CR1.2.description: Requests about forgotten passwords or password modifications, including cases where the password reset email was not received or went to junk mail.

CR1.3.label: Wrong account or unexpected account switching
CR1.3.description: Requests where the user is signed into the wrong account or is unexpectedly switched or logged into another account (e.g. linked accounts confusion, SSO selecting the wrong profile, multiple profiles).

CR1.4.label: Other sign-in issue
CR1.4.description: Sign-in issues not covered by the specific leaf codes above.

CR1.description: Issues preventing the customer from signing in, accessing their account, or authenticating via any method.

CR2.label: Account creation & setup

CR2.1.label: Registration failed
CR2.1.description: Requests where the user cannot create an account or complete registration (e.g. registration errors, being told the account already exists, email already in use with Elsevier, or sign-up not completing).

CR2.2.label: Verification link issue
CR2.2.description: Requests related to account verification links that have expired or are otherwise not working.

CR2.3.label: Other account setup issue
CR2.3.description: Account setup issues not covered above.

CR2.description: Issues encountered when creating a new account or completing initial account setup.

CR3.label: Account details & personal data

CR3.1.label: Update email address
CR3.1.description: Requests to update or change the email address associated with the account (e.g. moving institution, no longer having access to the registered address, multiple profiles).

CR3.2.label: Switch authentication method
CR3.2.description: Requests to convert or reclassify the account's authentication method (e.g. personal to institutional or vice versa, switching from Shibboleth to username/password after leaving an institution), including changes to account ownership or affiliation requiring a back-end update.

CR3.3.label: Account recovery
CR3.3.description: Requests to regain access to an existing account when standard login recovery cannot be completed (e.g. no longer has access to the registered email, account takeover concern, locked out after changes, recovery or verification step cannot be completed, accidental deletion).

CR3.4.label: Merge or transfer accounts
CR3.4.description: Requests to merge multiple accounts or transfer an account (e.g. after switching institution, expired email address, multiple accounts created over time).

CR3.5.label: Other account details & personal data
CR3.5.description: Account details & personal data not covered above.

CR3.description: Requests to update, recover, or change personal account information, authentication methods, or account ownership.

CR4.label: Organisation & network access

CR4.1.label: Institutional sign-in not working
CR4.1.description: Requests related to institutional sign-in failures (e.g. expired link, access blocked by institution, activation email not received, link invalid, verification not completing).

CR4.2.label: Access blocked by security or network controls
CR4.2.description: Requests where access is blocked by institutional or network-level security controls (e.g. firewall, IP restriction, institutional IT blocking access — customer advised to contact their admin).

CR4.3.label: Institution changed
CR4.3.description: Requests to update or switch the user's institution or SSO affiliation after moving universities or organisations.

CR4.4.label: No institutional entitlement
CR4.4.description: Requests where the user cannot access via their institution because the institution is not entitled, not subscribed, or not configured or enabled for access (e.g. SHIB not activated in CHIEF, institution not entitled).

CR4.5.label: Cannot join institution MIE group
CR4.5.description: Requests where the user cannot join or access their institution's MIE group (e.g. institution or group membership not recognised, invitation or entitlement issue, access blocked due to IP or network restrictions).

CR4.6.label: Other organisation & network access
CR4.6.description: Organisation & network access not covered above.

CR4.7.label: General enquiry
CR4.7.description: General questions not fitting any other category.

CR4.9.label: Unrelated contact
CR4.9.description: Contact that does not relate to any supported category.

CR4.description: Issues related to institutional or organisational access, network controls, or institutional configuration.
